camera.reason: Large 1/1.31 inch 50MP OIS main and a 50MP 5x periscope with OIS.

performance.reason: Dimensity 9500 is a current flagship chip.

battery.reason: 7,000mAh lasts two days and charges at 100W wired and 50W wireless.

display.reason: 6.83 inch AMOLED at 144Hz with 3,500 nits peak.

build.reason: Gorilla Glass 7i front and back, aluminium frame and IP68.

software.reason: Xiaomi T series phones get 5 Android upgrades (assumed for the 17T Pro).

value.reason: At 269,000 it brings a flagship chip, 7,000mAh battery and 5x periscope for about 50,000 less than the Galaxy S26.

availability.reason: Only PriceOye had it in stock; Xiaomi Pakistan lists it but shows no stock.

notes: PriceOye lists the 12GB 512GB at 268,999 in stock on 2026-10-11; WhatMobile shows an official price of 289,999. No other retailer we could check had it in stock. The update policy (5 Android upgrades, 6 years of patches) follows Xiaomi T series practice and is an assumption.
